attributes.name: [Chargeback] Deployment daily spend spike vs. 7-day baseline

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost
| EVAL threshold_pct_increase = 50.0, min_daily_spend = 25.0, filter_deployment = "*"
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND deployment_id IS NOT NULL
| INLINE STATS latest_ts = MAX(@timestamp) BY deployment_id
| WHERE @timestamp >= latest_ts - 7 days
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| EVAL is_onprem_row = COALESCE(is_onprem, ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", false), cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, cloud_sym = conf_currency_symbol
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, conf_currency_symbol
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_row, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL rate = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)),
       unit = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR")),
       currency_symbol = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_currency_symbol)) > 0, TRIM(conf_currency_symbol), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null), "€"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null), "€"))
| EVAL units = COALESCE(total_chargeable_units, 0.0)
| EVAL cost = units * rate
| EVAL deployment = COALESCE(deployment_name, deployment_id, "unknown")
| EVAL dep_group = CASE(deployment_group IS NOT NULL AND deployment_group != "", deployment_group, null)
| EVAL day_ts = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, ts)
| STATS day_spend = SUM(cost), day_units = SUM(units), day_deployment = MAX(deployment), day_group = MAX(dep_group), filter_deployment = MAX(filter_deployment), threshold_pct = MAX(threshold_pct_increase), min_spend = MAX(min_daily_spend), sym = COALESCE(MAX(currency_symbol), "€"), unit = COALESCE(MAX(unit), "EUR") BY day_ts, deployment_id
| INLINE STATS latest_day_ts = MAX(day_ts) BY deployment_id
| EVAL is_latest = (day_ts == latest_day_ts)
| EVAL latest_val = CASE(is_latest, day_spend, null), baseline_val = CASE(NOT is_latest, day_spend, null), latest_units_val = CASE(is_latest, day_units, null), latest_deployment = CASE(is_latest, day_deployment, null), latest_group = CASE(is_latest, day_group, null)
| STATS latest_spend = ROUND(MAX(latest_val), 2), baseline_avg = ROUND(AVG(baseline_val), 2), baseline_days = COUNT(baseline_val), units_total = ROUND(MAX(latest_units_val), 2), deployment = COALESCE(MAX(latest_deployment), MAX(day_deployment), deployment_id), all_deployments = VALUES(day_deployment), dep_group = COALESCE(MAX(latest_group), MAX(day_group), "ungrouped"), filter_deployment = MAX(filter_deployment), day = LEFT(TO_STRING(MAX(latest_day_ts)), 10), threshold_pct = MAX(threshold_pct), min_spend = MAX(min_spend), sym = COALESCE(MAX(sym), "€"), unit = COALESCE(MAX(unit), "EUR") BY deployment_id
| WHERE filter_deployment == "*" OR deployment == filter_deployment OR MV_CONTAINS(all_deployments, filter_deployment) OR deployment_id == filter_deployment
| WHERE latest_spend IS NOT NULL AND latest_spend >= min_spend AND baseline_days > 0 AND baseline_avg > 0.0
| EVAL pct_increase = ROUND((latest_spend - baseline_avg) * 100.0 / baseline_avg, 1)
| WHERE pct_increase > threshold_pct
| SORT pct_increase DESC, latest_spend DESC
| EVAL result = CONCAT("[", day, "] Deployment `", deployment, "` (", deployment_id, ", group=", dep_group, ") daily spend spiked +", TO_STRING(pct_increase), "% to ", sym, TO_STRING(latest_spend), " ", unit, " vs. ", TO_STRING(baseline_days), "-day baseline avg of ", sym, TO_STRING(baseline_avg), " ", unit, " (threshold: +", TO_STRING(threshold_pct), "%).")
| KEEP result, day, deployment, deployment_id, dep_group, latest_spend, baseline_avg, pct_increase, threshold_pct, unit
